steps.content: The empty courtyard shakes violently, mechanical cries and roars echo from the void. From the ominously expanding rift, countless light tendrils slowly emerged.
The tendrils move as if alive, illuminating everything. They touch Coquelic. She feels everything returning.

Surrounded by the tendrils of light, the entire space is filled with intense emotion. She breathes freely, as if all the rebellious power enters her body, all the vitality returns to her hands. It is the exhilarating feeling of regaining control of her life.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: How refreshing... I'm back.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: No one can control me, life is only so long, I'll squander it as I please. Love or hate, it's all up to me.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I won't sacrifice for anyone. I won't serve anyone. I'll take pleasure in my revenge. Every minute, every second, I will live freely.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I bloom for myself, I live for myself, I die for myself, the one I love most must only be myself. I must hold my fate in my own hands! This is the <color=#fb9259>Garden</color>! I've said it countless times!
She spreads her arms and looks up at the light, laughing and finally shedding tears.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: ...You guys should also live for yourselves... A bunch of fools...
Familiar smiling faces appear in the light, her flowers. She wants to hug them, protect them, she wants to sleep peacefully in her own Garden.
...The only one left with her in the end is this ice cold woman.

Shalom stands before the rift, among the light tendrils. All tendrils are drawn to Coquelic, giving her life and power, and conveying an inexplicable emotion—it is the first time she feels emotion from that doll.
She looks at Coquelic, with a hint of pity and sorrow, but more so, a cold anticipation.
All conditions to activate the power have been met, Shalom murmurs to herself.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I know you won't accept it. Your emotions are too intense, as naked as they are brilliant.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: If your life wasn't coming to an end, I would have chosen a milder method. But neither of us has time anymore.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: So resist all you want... I understand, I accept it all.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Even if the flowers I've touched are destined to wither, I must keep you alive.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: ...To hell with you.
She swings her sword and leaps into the light, merging with countless light tendrils. Now, only Shalom remains in her eyes and mind.

...That woman, whom she could never forgive, whom she refuses to submit to, has unknowingly occupied all of Coquelic's consciousness. She raises her sword to strike her enemy, but the woman opens her arms as if to completely embrace her.
Coquelic's life is being restored, but her consciousness is gradually dissolving...
Just as she is about to be swallowed by the light tendrils, the space suddenly fractured.
An unexpected person forcefully breaks through the invisible boundary, barging into the stormy space. At that moment, Coquelic clearly sees a flicker of surprise in the wax-like woman's eyes.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: <size=50>Stop it—!</size>
